verdict.rationale: vercel-gh-1 confirms users can start a deployment by 'choosing a template' alongside importing a project or using the CLI, which supports one-click templates/starters, but the evidence pack lacks any documentation of a template gallery, specific starter examples, or a dedicated one-click deploy flow beyond this single mention. missing for 10: dedicated template/starter gallery docs, specific example templates, independent hands-on confirmation of one-click deploy UX.
